summary: Preinstall dropper downloads Bun runtime and executes heavily obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/widget-platform-monolith 5.6.3 declares `scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x` identifiers) and, when the Bun runtime is not already present on the host, downloads the Bun binary from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, marks it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])` to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated blob (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, string-array rotation function, hex `_0xXXXX` identifier scheme) with no source maps or build artifacts explaining its behavior. Running the install-time payload under a freshly downloaded alternate language runtime evades Node-focused inspection. The package advertises itself as a ServiceTitan-scoped wrapper that re-exports `@servicetitan/widget-platform` from `dist/index.js`, providing a benign-looking cover for the preinstall dropper. The pattern — obfuscated preinstall script + download of an alternate runtime + execution of a large obfuscated sibling payload — is install-time remote code execution on any host running `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
